asked.item: Is this caused by low credits?
Same error on all three platforms at once

verdict.reason: S61 covers this exact error on every platform: it isn't a credits problem, retrying unchanged media won't help, and it lists what to check.

steps.text: This error is not a rate-limit or credits problem.
Retrying the same media without changes will not help.
Open each failed post in Posts > Failed to read its exact error, because the cause can differ per platform even when the message is the same.
Common causes are media that doesn't meet the platform's format or size specs, or a stale connection.
For a stale connection, reconnect the account in Accounts and retry.
